declaration.preface:
Choksi Heraeus Pvt. Ltd. is committed to conducting its business with the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and accountability. Ethical conduct forms the cornerstone of our operations, guiding every decision and interaction across all levels of the organization. This policy reflects our dedication to upholding ethical principles in all aspects of our business, whether in our dealings with employees, customers, suppliers, or the wider community.

Through this Ethical Conduct Policy, we aim to foster a culture of honesty, fairness, and mutual respect, while ensuring compliance with all applicable laws and internal codes of practice. It outlines the expectations placed on all stakeholders to act responsibly, avoid conflicts of interest, safeguard company assets, and uphold the reputation of Choksi Heraeus as a trusted and responsible corporate entity.
declaration.declaration: We at Choksi Heraeus are committed to maintain the highest standards of ethical behavior, integrity, and compliance in all business activities. All employees, management, and partners are expected to avoid conflicts of interest, refrain from bribery, corruption, and fraud, and ensure responsible use of company resources. Confidentiality must be respected, and all actions should align with applicable laws and internal policies. A safe, retaliation-free channel is maintained for reporting unethical conduct, reinforcing our culture of accountability and transparency.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, directors, contractors, and third-party partners of Choksi Heraeus across all locations. It governs ethical behavior in all business dealings, ensuring consistent standards across operations, subsidiaries, and entities acting on behalf of the company.

Integrity in Business Practices: Promote transparency, accountability, and adherence to ethical standards in all dealings ie: internal and external.
Maintain a culture of ethical decision-making at all organizational levels and ensure consistency in applying ethical standards in all internal and external operations.
Prevention of Corruption: Maintain zero tolerance toward bribery, kickbacks, and undue influence, ensuring compliance with all anti-corruption laws.
Maintain a zero-tolerance policy for bribery and corruption and ensure strict compliance with anti-corruption laws and company policies.
Conflict of Interest Management: Require timely disclosure of personal or professional interests that may interfere with impartial decision-making.
Promote a culture of transparency, encouraging employees to avoid situations where personal interests could conflict with business interests.
Ensure implementation of clear procedures for handling potential conflicts of interest fairly and impartially.
Fraud Prevention and Detection: Strengthen controls to detect, report, and prevent fraudulent acts through regular audits, awareness, and whistleblower mechanisms.
Provide training on identifying, preventing, and reporting fraud to all employees and encourage a culture of accountability, where fraudulent activities are promptly reported and addressed.
Strengthen awareness and controls through regular reviews.
Anti-Money Laundering Measures: Apply rigorous due diligence on financial transactions and third parties to identify and prevent money laundering activities.
Regularly monitor and audit financial transactions to detect any suspicious activity
Upholding Fair Competition: Ensure compliance with antitrust laws, prohibit unfair trade practices, and foster a competitive, ethical market environment.
Ensure compliance with fair competition and antitrust laws and hence promote transparency and fairness in all market dealings.
Responsible Information Handling: Safeguard sensitive company, client, and employee data, ensuring ethical use, storage, and communication of information.
Protect sensitive business, employee, and client data and hence promote responsible information security, storage, and access control.
Transparency in Recordkeeping: Maintain accurate, honest, and timely documentation across financial and operational processes to support legal and ethical accountability.
Enable full legal and operational traceability through systematic documentation.
Respect for Stakeholder Trust: Build long-term trust through ethical engagements with customers, suppliers, partners, and the community, ensuring responsible representation of the company’s values.

policy.monitoring:
At Choksi Heraeus Pvt. Ltd., Ethical Conduct practices are continuously enhanced to stay aligned with evolving regulations, industry standards, and emerging risks. A strong culture of integrity is embedded across all levels of the organization, ensuring transparency, accountability, and regulatory compliance.

Ongoing Training & Awareness: Employees undergo annual training on key ethical topics, including anti-corruption, conflict of interest, fraud prevention, anti-money laundering (AML), and information security.

Risk Assessments & Independent Audits: Regular internal reviews and third-party audits help identify potential ethical risks, evaluate policy effectiveness, and drive corrective actions.

Collaborative Compliance Engagement: Active participation in industry forums and regulatory dialogues supports alignment with best practices and ethical norms.

Advanced Monitoring & Reporting Systems: Secure digital tools and automated monitoring mechanisms strengthen fraud detection, compliance management, and incident reporting.

Feedback & Transparency Culture: Open channels for feedback empower employees and stakeholders to share concerns or suggestions, driving continual ethical improvements.

Choksi Heraeus Pvt. Ltd. maintains a zero-tolerance stance on all forms of ethical misconduct, including corruption, conflicts of interest, fraud, money laundering, and data breaches. Any confirmed violations are met with strict and proportionate disciplinary measures to uphold ethical standards.

Employees, suppliers, and external stakeholders are encouraged to report suspected violations through a secure and confidential whistleblower system that guarantees anonymity and protection against retaliation.

All reported concerns are treated with the utmost confidentiality and addressed through prompt and thorough investigation.

Investigations are led by the Compliance Officer, with support from internal teams or external experts as needed.

Confirmed violations may result in disciplinary actions such as warnings, suspension, termination, or legal action.

Suppliers found in violation of ethical standards may face contract suspension, financial penalties, or disqualification from future engagements.

Following any ethical breach, corrective actions such as policy updates, enhanced controls, or targeted training are implemented to prevent recurrence.

Insights gained from incidents are integrated into risk assessments and policy reviews, contributing to stronger ethical governance and resilience.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Ethical Conduct Policy is reviewed annually to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with legal and regulatory requirements. The Compliance Officer, in coordination with the Internal Audit Team and HR Department, is responsible for initiating the review process.

Updates may be made based on audit findings, changes in applicable laws, employee feedback, or evolving business practices. Any revisions are communicated to all employees, and necessary training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance.
